jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.program: 2027 Summer Clerkship Recruitment Program (scheme-wide dates for signatory firms)
jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027; the Society publishes two alternative closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm) which vary by participating firm, so no single close date is confirmed — offers can be made from 9:00am 8 September 2027, and eligibility is generally penultimate-year students.

Currently open on the firm's official graduate site with a stated close of Monday 2 November 2026 for the February 2027 intake; the original opening date is not published on the page, so 'opens' is null.
Firm's careers page confirms a future intake with applications opening in March 2027 for pre-penultimate-year students, but gives only the month, so exact open and close dates are not confirmed.

Firm's early careers page states applications are closed and will open in June 2027 for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program; only the month is given, so exact dates are not confirmed and will follow the relevant Law Society/LIV guidelines.

Firm's Adelaide application page confirms the 2026/27 round is closed and that 2027/28 applications will open in 'early 2027' under the SA Uniform Clerkship Scheme, with no specific dates published yet.
